title: Buga Sphere given to Jaime Maussan
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Buga Sphere given to Jaime Maussan, about 2025 at Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, Jaime Maussan was given this thing. It was taken in Buga, Colombia. That's why it's called the Buga Sphere.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, tells of the Buga Sphere, a metal ball named after the town of Buga in Colombia, where it was found. He says that in 2025 it was given to Jaime Maussan, a man in Mexico known for presenting UFO cases, and its backers suggest it could be an object not made by people.
